summary: Three bedroom apartment · Newcastle City Centre · Modern throughout · Available now
description:
My Property Box introduce to the market this three bedroom apartment situated on Waterloo Street, Newcastle City Centre.

Situated on the fifth floor of the popular development on Waterloo Street, the top floor apartment is accessed via secured communal entrance with elevator access to the fifth floor. The apartment itself boasts three bedrooms, large open plan living room-diner accompanied by a modern U-shaped kitchen, split bathroom. Having undergone extensive refurbishment works, the apartment has a spacious yet homely feel and has views over Newcastle City Centre.

Fitted with new furnishings throughout, the apartment is ideal for a couple or two sharers who desire convenient access to the rest of Newcastle's lively City Centre, whilst being in a safe & quiet apartment block. There are also communal gardens for the block to the rear of the building.

Available now. Please note that this property is not suitable for three sharers. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak with the Lettings Team.
